subject: Hatchery cohort: request for program credits and short extension
messages:
From: Sarah Connor <sarah@saasfoundry.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Frank Ellis <frank@seedcap.vc>
Date: 2026-08-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Hatchery cohort credits + 30-day extension

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here at SaaSFoundry got excited about Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching during the generator demo. We're kicking off our Hatchery accelerator cohort on Sep 6 and we'd like to request a program allocation for the cohort and a short extension to our trial window.

High-level ask:
- Credits: ~$30,000 worth of usage (we can convert to tokens if you prefer) to cover 8 teams running integrations for ~6 weeks.
- Extension: +30 days on the existing trial (would make the trial 90 days total).

Why this matters: the cohort will use Redwood for chat+code-assist features and we expect a spike during the second week of the program. Having the credits + extension will let our teams validate infra and help with momentum for a paid pilot.

I've attached a short cohort scope and our internal MAAP for the security team to review (attachments: Hatchery_Cohort_Scope.pdf, SaaSFoundry_MAAP.pdf).

Questions for you:
1) Is this something Redwood can support programmatically (promo code / top-up) or do we need an addendum?
2) Any usage caps or SLOs we should be aware of for program allocations?
3) Can we get a one-page summary of the support/SLAs for cohort participants?

If helpful, I'm happy to set up a 30-minute call with our ops lead and your CS partner this week.

Thanks —
Sarah Connor
Director, Accelerator Programs
SaaSFoundry

Subject: Re: Request: Hatchery cohort credits + 30-day extension

Hi Sarah — great to hear the demo landed well. Thanks for the context and the attachments; I skimmed the cohort scope and it looks straightforward. A few clarifying items so I can route this for an internal approval quickly: 

- Current trial state: are you already on a live trial account tied to SaaSFoundry org or are the teams on individual dev keys?
- Teams & scale: can you confirm ~number of teams (you said 8) and expected peak concurrent sessions / tokens per day so we can size the credit uplift?
- Security: the MAAP is helpful — we'll need security to confirm any production-like integrations. Can you point me to the contact who will own the security review?
- Timeline: you mentioned a Sep 6 start — is that fixed?

Prelim answer: we generally support program credit top-ups via a one-time promo allocation tied to the account; extensions to trial windows and addendums are possible but need sign-off from Growth/Finance (cc'ing Laura). For anything above $20k in credits we typically require a short pilot addendum and a procurement contact for billing acceptance.

I can set up a quick call with Laura and Marcus tomorrow if that helps — would you prefer 10:00am or 3:30pm PT?

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah & Priyom — looping in to confirm next steps.

Outcome: Growth approves a provisional program allocation. We can offer SaaSFoundry a one-time credit top-up of $25,000 and extend the trial window by 60 days (we're willing to be flexible there given accelerator cadence). This is contingent on the following conditions:

- Security sign-off on the MAAP (we will share to Security and expect the review to complete within 5 business days).
- A short pilot addendum signed by SaaSFoundry agreeing to the program terms (we'll send a DocuSign link).
- Usage cap: initial quota enforced at account level — if you exceed the expected tokens/day we will surface an overage alert and we reserve the right to pause the allocation pending review.

Operational items for Priyom to collect: procurement contact for SaaSFoundry (name/email/PO requirements), preferred billing contact, and the expected cohort admin account that will receive the promo code.

I've attached the standard pilot addendum template for your review (pilot-addendum-template.pdf). Marcus — please confirm finance OK on the $25k top-up and whether we need FSM approval for credit >$20k.

Sarah — if that termset looks good, we'll issue a DocuSign and a promo code that the cohort admin can apply at account level; code will expire 45 days after issuance if not used.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
